preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The value of k is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(97 <= ord(c) <= 122 for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (1 <= len(output) <= len(S) and all(97 <= ord(c) <= 122 for c in output))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a string with lowercase alphabets of length between 1 and the length of S.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if len(S) <= k else len(output) == len(S) - k
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it is not possible to remove k characters. Otherwise, the length of the output is len(S) - k.
If the output is not -1, the lexicographically smallest character in the output is the same as or lexicographically smaller than the smallest character in the original string S.
